name: Qwen 3.8 Max
short: Alibaba's Qwen3.8 Max hosted multimodal MoE (2.4T/95B, 1M context) for code/reasoning/visual agents; SWE-bench Pro 67.7%, GPQA ~93.7% at $2/$6 per 1M. Open weights ship as Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, text-only.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: Alibaba's everything-at-once hosted flagship: a 2.4T multimodal MoE handling code, reasoning and visual agents over 1M context, with open Max-class weights.
tradeoff: Vision, non-thinking mode and the seven built-in tools are hosted-API-only; the weights themselves are open as Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, text-only, so self-hosters give up the vision ceiling, not the model.
